title: [Screen Ruler] DIP measurement unit cannot be selected

status.label: Fix design ready
status.detail: The report includes exact repro steps, visual evidence, and points to the Settings UI normalization bug: DIP uses index 4, but the view model caps valid units at 3 and maps value 4 to centimeters for legacy migration.

judgment.rationale: The bug is reproducible from the supplied steps and confirmed by source: Settings UI normalizes UnitsOfMeasure value 4 away from DIP, so selecting DIP immediately persists/displays centimeters.
evidence: Issue 50684 reports that selecting Display-independent pixels immediately reverts to Centimeters and includes visual evidence.
settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/MeasureToolViewModel.cs sets MaximumUnitsOfMeasureIndex = 3 while DIP is index 4.
NormalizeUnitsOfMeasureIndex maps value 4 to 2 for legacy Measurement::Unit migration, which collides with the new DIP combo-box index.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused Screen Ruler Settings fix so DIP can be selected without breaking legacy centimetre/millimetre migration.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked existing fix covers the Settings UI normalization path for the new DIP option.

proposed_fixes.title: Separate legacy unit migration from the current combo-box DIP index
proposed_fixes.root_cause: MeasureToolViewModel uses a single NormalizeUnitsOfMeasureIndex method for both current combo-box validation and legacy persisted enum migration. After adding DIP at index 4, the legacy migration rule 4 => 2 still runs for live UI values and MaximumUnitsOfMeasureIndex remains 3, so DIP is normalized back to centimeters.
plan: Update MeasureToolViewModel so the current UnitsOfMeasure setter/getter accepts every current combo-box index, including DIP at index 4.

Restrict legacy enum migration to persisted values that can be distinguished from current combo-box values, or move migration behind an explicit version/one-time repair path so a user-selected DIP value is not rewritten to centimeters.
Update Settings UI unit tests so value 4 remains DIP after construction and setter normalization, while any truly legacy centimetre/millimetre persisted values still migrate as intended.
Manually verify Settings > Screen Ruler can select DIP and launching Screen Ruler displays pixel and DIP measurements.
verification: Manual: enable Screen Ruler, choose Display-independent pixels under Extra units of measurement, close/reopen Settings, and confirm the selection remains DIP.
Manual: launch Screen Ruler and confirm measurements show pixels plus DIPs rather than centimeters.

confidence.rationale: The report identifies the exact normalization method and constants, and source inspection confirms value 4 is both the new DIP index and the legacy centimetre migration input.

issue_context.summary: Screen Ruler Settings cannot retain the new Display-independent pixels extra-unit option; selecting it immediately reverts to Centimeters and Screen Ruler shows centimeters.
known_information: Reporter is on current main/0.102 dev build in Visual Studio.
Repro steps: enable Screen Ruler, select Display-independent pixels for Extra units of measurement.
Actual behavior: selection reverts to Centimeters and Screen Ruler measurements use pixels plus centimeters.
The issue includes a short recording/image and identifies NormalizeUnitsOfMeasureIndex and MaximumUnitsOfMeasureIndex as likely causes.
inferences: The issue is in Settings persistence/normalization rather than Screen Ruler measurement rendering, because the selected Settings value is rewritten immediately.
The new DIP combo-box index collides with legacy Measurement::Unit enum migration value 4.
issue_context.analysis: Source inspection confirms the Settings view model accepts only indices 0..3 and rewrites value 4 to 2. Because DIP is now index 4, the current normalization path treats a valid UI selection as a legacy centimeters value.
initial_investigation: NormalizeUnitsOfMeasureIndex returns 2 for value 4 before checking the valid combo-box range.
Existing unit tests assert value 4 repairs to 2, so tests must be updated with the new DIP behavior and any replacement legacy migration coverage.

design.root_cause: The Settings UI normalization code has not been updated for the new DIP option. It still treats integer value 4 as an old persisted Measurement::Unit enum value that should migrate to centimeters, and the valid combo-box maximum is still 3.
evidence: Issue repro and screenshot show DIP cannot be retained.
Unit test ConstructorRepairsInvalidPersistedUnitsOfMeasureIndex currently expects 4 to become 2.

affected_files.purpose: Normalizes and persists the Screen Ruler extra units selected in Settings.
Covers Screen Ruler Settings normalization behavior.
Covers serialization of Screen Ruler unit values.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Valid values are capped at 3 and value 4 is always normalized to centimeters.
implementation_steps.change: Accept the DIP combo-box index as a current valid value. Do not apply the legacy 4 => 2 migration to a current DIP selection; either separate one-time legacy migration from UI normalization or gate migration on a persisted-version signal.
edge_cases: Existing users with millimetre legacy value 8 should still migrate correctly if that migration path is retained.
Invalid negative or out-of-range values should still fall back to default.
Do not rewrite a user-selected DIP value during constructor repair.
tests: Add/adjust unit coverage so value 4 remains 4 for current combo-box normalization.
Keep coverage for invalid values falling back to default and legacy millimetre migration if supported.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Tests currently encode 4 => 2, matching the broken DIP behavior.
implementation_steps.change: Update expectations for current DIP index 4 and add a separate migration-specific test only if the implementation keeps an explicit legacy migration path.
edge_cases: Ensure tests clarify whether they cover current combo-box indices or old persisted enum migration.
tests: Run the MeasureTool Settings UI unit tests.

verify: Manual Settings verification with Screen Ruler enabled and DIP selected.
risks: Changing migration can affect users with old Screen Ruler unit settings; separate current index validation from legacy migration to avoid regressions.
alternatives: If persisted settings cannot distinguish old enum value 4 from new DIP index 4, prefer preserving the user-visible current DIP selection and document/limit legacy centimetre migration rather than keeping DIP unusable.
